plugins.name: qq-wechat-persona
plugins.description: Persona companion bot for QQ and WeChat: ZCode acts as the brain; NapCat carries QQ traffic; ADB drives WeChat on an emulator or USB phone. Persona management, SQLite long-term memory, relationship profiles, sticker library, blacklist/whitelist, human-like rate limiting, proactive chat.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 即大脑的 QQ/微信人格机器人：人格管理、长期记忆、关系画像、表情包库、黑白名单、拟人防风控、主动聊天。QQ 走 NapCat 协议，微信走 ADB（模拟器/USB 真机）。
